title: Field water-management advisory for rain-fed rice areas
riskSummary: Short intense rainfall and uneven distribution can still leave some rain-fed rice fields under water-management stress. This local risk assessment is synthetic and used for prototype demonstration.
actions: Check actual field water level before irrigation decisions.
Prioritize water during sensitive crop stages where supply is limited.
Report visible crop stress and local water constraints to the extension officer.
Avoid treating province-wide rainfall totals as a substitute for field conditions.
